request.system: You are a fraud analytics feature engineer. Task: rank Medicare providers for audit. Each of 5,410 providers carries a PotentialFraud label (9.35% flagged) whose origin is undocumented; treat it as suspicion, not confirmed fraud. Claims run 27 Nov 2008 to 31 Dec 2009. The primary metric is PR-AUC; the audit queue holds about 100 providers. Existing provider features are grouped into families below. Propose new provider-level features that describe HOW a provider bills rather than HOW MUCH, because claim volume already explains most of the label. Use only the claim columns and provider bases the schema allows. Never use the label. (Independent run 3.)

claim_aggregates.name: agent_los_max_ip
claim_aggregates.rationale: Captures maximum length of stay for inpatient claims to detect extreme outlier billing behavior.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_claim_days_std
claim_aggregates.rationale: Measures variability in claim duration which indicates inconsistent service patterns.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_ndiag_mean_op
claim_aggregates.rationale: Tracks average number of diagnoses per outpatient claim for coding inflation.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_nproc_max_ip
claim_aggregates.rationale: Identifies maximum procedures per inpatient claim to spot unusually heavy coding.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_reimb_std_all
claim_aggregates.rationale: Measures overall dispersion of reimbursed amounts across all claims.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_deductible_share_op
claim_aggregates.rationale: Proportion of outpatient claims with non-zero deductible reported.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_age_median_all
claim_aggregates.rationale: Median beneficiary age treated by provider to check for demographic targeting.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_chronic_mean_all
claim_aggregates.rationale: Average chronic conditions per beneficiary associated with provider claims.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_renal_share_all
claim_aggregates.rationale: Share of claims associated with renal disease indicator.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_dead_share_all
claim_aggregates.rationale: Share of claims where beneficiary is marked as deceased.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_dup_any_share
claim_aggregates.rationale: Proportion of claims flagged for any duplication.

claim_aggregates.name: agent_att_is_op_share
claim_aggregates.rationale: Share of claims where attending physician is also operating physician.

ratios.name: agent_bene_per_claim
ratios.rationale: Ratio of unique beneficiaries to total claims, capturing patient reuse intensity.

ratios.name: agent_ip_claim_ratio
ratios.rationale: Proportion of claims that are inpatient.

ratios.name: agent_op_claim_ratio
ratios.rationale: Proportion of claims that are outpatient.

ratios.name: agent_ip_reimb_ratio
ratios.rationale: Share of total reimbursement coming from inpatient claims.

ratios.name: agent_attending_per_claim
ratios.rationale: Ratio of distinct attending physicians per claim to measure physician diversity.

ratios.name: agent_operating_per_claim
ratios.rationale: Ratio of distinct operating physicians per claim.

ratios.name: agent_states_per_bene
ratios.rationale: Geographic dispersion of beneficiaries relative to beneficiary count.

ratios.name: agent_dgc_per_claim
ratios.rationale: Diagnosis group code count relative to total claims.
